items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to what good mental health means, cultural variations in diagnosis, and the social and economic effects of mental illness.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: BBC Radio 4's long-running series on mental health and psychology — episodes cover stigma, diagnosis, and what it means to be mentally healthy.

items.title: Psychological Disorders: Crash Course Psychology #28
items.description: Crash Course overview of how psychologists define, classify, and diagnose psychological disorders — great context for understanding what makes something a 'disorder' rather than normal variation.

items.title: How to practice emotional first aid — Guy Winch (TED)
items.description: TED talk exploring why we neglect our mental health compared to physical health, and what emotional first aid looks like in everyday life.

items.title: Inside Out (2015)
items.description: Pixar film that uses personified emotions to explore how mental states drive behaviour — a warm, accessible introduction to the psychology of emotion and wellbeing for GCSE students.

items.title: I had a black dog, his name was depression — WHO
items.description: World Health Organisation animated short based on Matthew Johnstone's book — a sensitive and stigma-reducing portrayal of what depression feels like from the inside.

items.title: YoungMinds — Mental Health Hub
items.description: UK charity site aimed at young people, with plain-English guides to a wide range of mental health conditions and where to get help.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology specification
items.description: Official AQA spec — check exactly what the examiners expect you to know about mental health definitions and cultural variation.
